*Aubrey's page came out of a chest of old Guard drill books. He wants the rest of the book, and old paper in this city ends up in the Academy or down the drains. Go down to the Cisterns, clear 30 of what lives there and search an old shelf.*

1. Reach [The Cisterns](../maps/cisterns.md)
